verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented template or authoring guide for writing a new SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter. The only route shown is copying or reading the existing skill files, such as the probe's installed tdd SKILL.md with `name: tdd`, which is the reverse-engineering the story rules out. Editable installed files are an adjacent feature and do not count as an authoring template.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
